script:
-- Global State Variables
local IsVerified = false
local QuizStep = 1
local SpamActive = false
local SpamDelay = 2
local CustomText = "APX H8R TMX"
local MatrixActive = false

-- Services
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

-- Chat Sending Utility
local function SendChatMessage(msg)
    if #msg > 195 then
        msg = string.sub(msg, 1, 195)
    end
    
    local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")
    if TextChatService.ChatVersion == Enum.ChatVersion.TextChatService then
        local generalChannel = TextChatService.TextChannels:FindFirstChild("RBXGeneral")
        if generalChannel then
            generalChannel:SendAsync(msg)
        end
    else
        ReplicatedStorage.DefaultChatSystemChatEvents.SayMessageRequest:FireServer(msg, "All")
    end
end

---------------------------------------------------------
-- RED COLOR RP NAME SETTER (PURE RED COLOR - NO FONTS)
---------------------------------------------------------
local function SetRedRPName()
    pcall(function()
        local RedRPName = '<font color="#FF0000">Apx 🌸spammer</font>'
        
        local bhFolder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Brookhaven") or ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("BHGameData") or ReplicatedStorage
        local setNameEvent = (
            bhFolder:FindFirstChild("SetName") or
            bhFolder:FindFirstChild("ChangeName") or
            bhFolder:FindFirstChild("NameChangeEvent") or
            ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("SetRPName") or
            ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("ChangeRPName")
        )
        if setNameEvent then
            setNameEvent:FireServer(RedRPName)
        end

        for _, v in ipairs(ReplicatedStorage:GetDescendants()) do
            if v:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
                local lname = v.Name:lower()
                if lname:find("name") or lname:find("rp") or lname:find("title") then
                    pcall(function() v:FireServer(RedRPName) end)
                end
            end
        end

        local char = LocalPlayer.Character or LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait()
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then 
            hum.DisplayName = "Apx 🌸spammer"
        end
    end)
end

task.spawn(function()
    task.wait(1.5)
    SetRedRPName()
end)

LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    task.wait(1)
    SetRedRPName()
end)

---------------------------------------------------------

local QuestionText = Instance.new("TextLabel")

QuestionText.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 30, 30)

QuestionText.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
QuestionText.Parent = Background

local YesBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
YesBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.3, 0, 0.1, 0)
YesBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.18, 0, 0.55, 0)
YesBtn.Text = "YES"
YesBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 180, 80)
YesBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)

YesBtn.Parent = Background

local NoBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")

NoBtn.Text = "NO"
NoBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 40, 40)
NoBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
NoBtn.TextScaled = true
NoBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
NoBtn.Parent = Background

YesBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if QuizStep == 1 then
        QuizStep = 2
        QuestionText.Text = "Let's destroy?"
    elseif QuizStep == 2 then
        IsVerified = true
        QuizGui:Destroy()
    end
end)

NoBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    QuizGui:Destroy()
    game.Players.LocalPlayer:Kick("Verification Failed: Access Denied.")
end)

repeat task.wait(0.1) until IsVerified == true

---------------------------------------------------------
-- TAB 1: Spammer Controls
---------------------------------------------------------
local MainTab = Window:CreateTab("Spammer Main", 4483362458)

MainTab:CreateInput({
   Name = "Custom Message Input",
   PlaceholderText = "Default: APX H8R TMX",
   RemoveTextAfterFocusLost = false,
   Callback = function(Text)
       if Text and #Text > 0 then
           CustomText = string.upper(Text)
       else
           CustomText = "APX H8R TMX"
       end
   end,
})

MainTab:CreateSlider({
   Name = "Spam Delay (Seconds)",
   Range = {1, 50},
   Increment = 1,
   Suffix = " Seconds",
   CurrentValue = 2,
   Flag = "SpamDelaySlider",
   Callback = function(Value)
       SpamDelay = Value
   end,
})

MainTab:CreateButton({
   Name = "▶ START SPAMMER",
   Callback = function()
       if SpamActive then return end
       SpamActive = true
       Rayfield:Notify({Title = "Spammer", Content = "Spammer Started!", Duration = 2})
       
       task.spawn(function()
           local msgIndex = 1
           while SpamActive do
               local currentMsg = SpammerMessages[msgIndex]
               local fullMsg = currentMsg .. " - " .. string.upper(CustomText)
               
               SendChatMessage(fullMsg)
               msgIndex = (msgIndex % #SpammerMessages) + 1
               task.wait(SpamDelay)
           end
       end)
   end,
})

MainTab:CreateButton({
   Name = "⏹ STOP SPAMMER",
   Callback = function()
       SpamActive = false
       Rayfield:Notify({Title = "Spammer", Content = "Spammer Stopped!", Duration = 2})
   end,
})

-- TAB 2: BROOKHAVEN ALPHA ROBOT PROP MENU (10 KHATARNAK OPTIONS)
---------------------------------------------------------
local RobotTab = Window:CreateTab("🤖 Alpha Robot Prop Menu", 4483362458)

local function BuildAlphaRobotGUI()
    if CoreGui:FindFirstChild("AlphaRobotGUIWindow") then
        CoreGui.AlphaRobotGUIWindow:Destroy()
    end

    local RobotGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    RobotGui.Name = "AlphaRobotGUIWindow"
    RobotGui.Parent = CoreGui

    local MainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
    MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 340, 0, 420)
    MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.32, 0, 0.2, 0)
    MainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 25)
    MainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 2
    MainFrame.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
    MainFrame.Active = true
    MainFrame.Draggable = true
    MainFrame.Parent = RobotGui

    local TitleLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    TitleLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 35)
    TitleLabel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 0, 10)
    TitleLabel.Text = "⚡ ALPHA ROBOT KHATARNAK MENU ⚡"
    TitleLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50)
    TitleLabel.TextScaled = true
    TitleLabel.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
    TitleLabel.Parent = MainFrame

    local CloseBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    CloseBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 30)
    CloseBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 2)
    CloseBtn.Text = "X"
    CloseBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    CloseBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 0, 0)
    CloseBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
    CloseBtn.Parent = MainFrame
    CloseBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        RobotGui:Destroy()
    end)

    local ScrollFrame = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
    ScrollFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 1, -45)
    ScrollFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 40)
    ScrollFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    ScrollFrame.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 620)
    ScrollFrame.ScrollBarThickness = 6
    ScrollFrame.Parent = MainFrame

    local UIList = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
    UIList.Parent = ScrollFrame
    UIList.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
    UIList.Padding = UDim.new(0, 8)

    local function CreateMenuButton(order, text, color, callback)
        local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
        btn.Size = UDim2.new(0.95, 0, 0, 48)
        btn.Position = UDim2.new(0.025, 0, 0, 0)
        btn.Text = text
        btn.BackgroundColor3 = color
        btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        btn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
        btn.TextSize = 18
        btn.LayoutOrder = order
        btn.Parent = ScrollFrame
        btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(callback)
        return btn
    end

    -- Auto-Give Item Call
    pcall(function()
        local giveItemRemote = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("GiveItem", true) or ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("PickItem", true)
        if giveItemRemote then
            giveItemRemote:FireServer("RobotBox")
            giveItemRemote:FireServer("MechaSuit")
        end
    end)

    -- OPTION 1: DEPLOY MECHA ROBOT
    CreateMenuButton(1, "1. 🤖 DEPLOY MECHA ROBOT", Color3.fromRGB(200, 20, 20), function()
        pcall(function()
            local char = LocalPlayer.Character or LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait()
            local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if hum and hrp then
                hum.WalkSpeed = 50
                hum.JumpPower = 100
                local sparks = Instance.new("Sparkles")
                sparks.Name = "AlphaRobotSpark"
                sparks.SparkleColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 50)
                sparks.Parent = hrp
                local propRemote = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("PlaceProp", true) or ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("SpawnProp", true)
                if propRemote then propRemote:FireServer("RobotBox", hrp.CFrame) end
            end
        end)
    end)

    -- OPTION 2: RED PLASMA AURA
    local AuraActive = false
    CreateMenuButton(2, "2. 🔥 RED PLASMA AURA (TOGGLE)", Color3.fromRGB(180, 50, 0), function()
        AuraActive = not AuraActive
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        if char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            local hrp = char.HumanoidRootPart
            if AuraActive then
                local fire = Instance.new("Fire", hrp)
                fire.Name = "AlphaAuraFire"
                fire.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
                fire.SecondaryColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 0)
                fire.Size = 15
            else
                if hrp:FindFirstChild("AlphaAuraFire") then hrp.AlphaAuraFire:Destroy() end
            end
        end
    end)

    -- OPTION 3: SPINBOT TORNADO
    local SpinActive = false
    CreateMenuButton(3, "3. 🌀 SPINBOT TORNADO (TOGGLE)", Color3.fromRGB(150, 0, 180), function()
        SpinActive = not SpinActive
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        if char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            local hrp = char.HumanoidRootPart
            if SpinActive then
                local spin = Instance.new("BodyAngularVelocity")
                spin.Name = "AlphaSpin"
                spin.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(0, math.huge, 0)
                spin.AngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 50, 0)
                spin.Parent = hrp
            else
                if hrp:FindFirstChild("AlphaSpin") then hrp.AlphaSpin:Destroy() end
            end
        end
    end)

    -- OPTION 4: MECH FLY / HOVER MODE
    local Flying = false
    CreateMenuButton(4, "4. 🚀 MECH FLY MODE (TOGGLE)", Color3.fromRGB(0, 120, 200), function()
        Flying = not Flying
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        if char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            local hrp = char.HumanoidRootPart
            if Flying then
                local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
                bv.Name = "AlphaFly"
                bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
                bv.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 25, 0)
                bv.Parent = hrp
            else
                if hrp:FindFirstChild("AlphaFly") then hrp.AlphaFly:Destroy() end
            end
        end
    end)

    -- OPTION 5: GOD SHIELD HIGHLIGHT
    local ShieldActive = false
    CreateMenuButton(5, "5. 🛡️ RED GOD SHIELD (TOGGLE)", Color3.fromRGB(220, 0, 80), function()
        ShieldActive = not ShieldActive
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        if char then
            if ShieldActive then
                local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
                hl.Name = "AlphaShield"
                hl.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 50)
                hl.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                hl.FillTransparency = 0.3
                hl.Parent = char
            else
                if char:FindFirstChild("AlphaShield") then char.AlphaShield:Destroy() end
            end
        end
    end)

    -- OPTION 6: EXPLOSIVE SHOCKWAVE BLAST
    CreateMenuButton(6, "6. 💥 EXPLOSIVE SHOCKWAVE", Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 0), function()
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        if char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            local exp = Instance.new("Explosion")
            exp.Position = char.HumanoidRootPart.Position
            exp.BlastRadius = 15
            exp.BlastPressure = 0 -- Visual Shockwave Only
            exp.Parent = workspace
        end
    end)

    -- OPTION 7: NOCLIP GHOST MODE
    local Noclip = false
    CreateMenuButton(7, "7. 👻 NOCLIP / GHOST MODE", Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 200), function()
        Noclip = not Noclip
        task.spawn(function()
            while Noclip do
                pcall(function()
                    for _, part in ipairs(LocalPlayer.Character:GetDescendants()) do
                        if part:IsA("BasePart") then part.CanCollide = false end
                    end
                end)
                task.wait(0.1)
            end
        end)
    end)

    -- OPTION 8: ULTRA SPEED RUSH (200 WALK)
    CreateMenuButton(8, "8. ⚡ ULTRA SPEED RUSH (200)", Color3.fromRGB(0, 180, 100), function()
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        if char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
            char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid").WalkSpeed = 200
        end
    end)

    -- OPTION 9: SKY DOMAIN TELEPORT
    CreateMenuButton(9, "9. 🌌 TELEPORT TO SKY DOMAIN", Color3.fromRGB(120, 0, 220), function()
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        if char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 500, 0)
        end
    end)

    -- OPTION 10: ALPHA DESTRUCTION CHAT BLAST
    CreateMenuButton(10, "10. ⚡ CHAT DOMINATION BLAST", Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0), function()
        SendChatMessage("🔥🔥 ALPHA ROBOT OVERLORD DOMINATING THE SERVER 🔥🔥")
    end)
end

RobotTab:CreateButton({
   Name = "Open Alpha Robot GUI Panel",
   Callback = function()
       BuildAlphaRobotGUI()
   end,
})
